blocks.text: Values are median (Q1, Q3) or n (%) from available pre-imputation study records. Percentages use nonmissing denominators. Development HBV DNA available n: continuous 178/126 and categorical 182/127 for no readmission/readmission. All displayed analytical fields are available in both internal-validation groups.

Development HBV DNA available n: continuous 178/126 and categorical 182/127 for no readmission/readmission. All displayed analytical fields are available in both internal-validation groups.

blocks.text: P values compare outcome groups within each cohort using two-sided Mann-Whitney U tests for continuous variables and chi-squared or Fisher exact tests for categorical variables. These exploratory comparisons are unadjusted and did not determine feature-selection entry. Clinical manifestations may coexist.

blocks.text: Metabolic comorbidities denote obesity, hypertension or diabetes mellitus; obesity was defined as BMI ≥28 kg/m². HBeAg/anti-HBe categories are the four positive/negative combinations. Viral-marker coding and limitations are in Table S3A.
